[AI engineering](../index.qmd) / Multimodal and realtime systems

Choose the interface and timing that fit the task: documents, images, speech, video or interactive audio.

## What to understand

- **Vision and documents:** image understanding, document extraction, spatial details and grounded source locations.
- **Audio:** transcription, speech generation, language handling and noisy recordings.
- **Realtime interaction:** streaming audio, turn detection, interruption, tool latency and recovery.
- **Image and video generation:** controllability, review, provenance and task-specific quality checks.
- **Modality-specific evaluation:** transcription errors, visual extraction accuracy and whether generated media meets the actual brief.
- **User experience:** consent, recording indicators, visible system state and graceful text fallback.

## How the pieces connect

Modality cuts across the map. A voice agent still needs tools, evaluation, security and operations; it is not a replacement for those layers.

## A question to test

Use the same small task in text and one additional modality. Measure the new error modes and waiting time instead of treating a compelling demo as sufficient evidence.
